chain_of_custody.notes: Log files copied; full disk image in progress

untampered_primary_evidence: EVT-002 Sysmon.evtx — fills Security.evtx gap window
LNX-001 audit.log — complete Linux escalation evidence
CLD-001 cloudtrail — AWS credential abuse; cloud-side; tamper-resistant
evidence_integrity_summary.forensic_conclusion: Despite attacker clearing Security.evtx and System.evtx, corroborating evidence from Sysmon.evtx, auditd, Zeek, and CloudTrail reconstructs the complete attack timeline with high confidence. Evidence chain sufficient for legal proceedings.
